description: This file defines an interface 'ResourceLimitChecks' for checking resource limits such as connection count and message count for tenants in a service. It declares methods to perform asynchronous checks using Vert.x Futures, and references external classes for tenant configuration and exception handling.

classes.name: ResourceLimitChecks
classes.description: An interface providing methods to asynchronously check if resource limits for a tenant have been reached.

methods.name: isConnectionLimitReached
methods.description: Checks whether the maximum number of connections configured for a tenant has been reached. Returns a Future<Boolean> indicating the status.

methods.name: isMessageLimitReached
methods.description: Checks whether the maximum message limit for a tenant has been reached, given the payload size. Returns a Future<Boolean> indicating the status.
